page0.text:
"Haah... Haah... Haah..."
And I fall.
I can't even breathe properly.
The wound on my shoulder is red and swollen, and it hurts like crazy when I breathe.

page1.text:
...
I'm unable to stay conscious.
If I let my guard down, I'll fall asleep immediately.
...No, I'm not even sure if I'm awake in the first place.
It's not even clear how I made it back here from that rooftop or why I came home.

page2.text:
...My thoughts become ambiguous.
The only certain thing is my beating heart.

page3.text:
...
...Tohsaka told me not to get involved.
Because I am powerless and don't have a reason to fight anymore.

page4.text:
...
But, that's wrong.
I knew more than anyone that I was powerless.
I had a different reason for fighting.

page5.text:
...I can't just let it become a scar.
Losing against others is inevitable.
I'm used to getting knocked down, and I know that it's vexing that I can't reach them no matter what I do.

page6.text:
But that is only when my opponent is someone else.
I can't lose against myself.
There is no factor that would make me lose if our powers are equal.
To submit to an opponent like that would be like declaring that I'm wrong.

page7.text:
"Ugh!"
My wound distorts.
The blood seeps through my bandage.

page8.text:
"Ah... Ugh...!"
I hold it down with my right hand and glare at the darkness with my fading consciousness.
The memory from ten years ago.
The words of the man that was my father.

page9.text:
...Even if I was wrong from the start, there is nothing wrong with the path I took.
I wanted to become a hero of justice so that incident wouldn't just become a sad past.
A time where everyone would be happy.
I held onto the ideal, where nobody would shed tears, for ten years.

page10.text:
"...Then..."
It doesn't matter how much my mind doesn't function.
What needs to be done had been determined from the start.
I didn't fight because I became a Master.
I decided to fight because I believed that since it was something I could do, it was something I must do.
I finally remembered something that was so obvious.

page11.text:
"...Tohsaka. No matter how much you tell me..."
If I believe it is right, I will believe in this path until the very end.
I can't just quit like this, and I won't let her fight by herself.

page12.text:
...For that sake, I'll sleep now.
I won't let her call me a burden.
I'll heal this wound in a night.
And when I wake up in the morning...

page13.text:
...When I wake up in the morning.
I'll definitely catch up to her, and finally repay her for what she did that night...
